purpose: Compare useful defect review with the same hidden oracle and worker-visible revision/context. Source calibration is separate from reviewer performance.

arms.form: native exec review; pin base/head and native review instructions
upstream local Git review, not an assumed native skill loader
arms.inclusion_condition: Only a named reviewer gap; no automatic replacement of native cross-family review

routing.gateway: existing keyless OmniRoute; no new credential, sign-in copy or service switch
routing.native_review_contract: Clones parent configuration and selects review_model or the turn model; disables web search, Collab and MultiAgentV2; approval Never. No final-output JSON schema is passed to the review child. Source does not establish delivered effort or CLI structured capture.

calibration.native_oracle: 0.7*recall+0.3*precision; object pass requires recall>=0.75 and precision>=0.5. Numeric threshold and relative winner are separate assertion paths.
calibration.limits: Two auth fixtures provide calibration only. Returning both IDs on the timing-only row yields score0.85 and passes; this is not a strict false-positive or clean-review oracle. Stock SDK generation is not native CLI ReviewOutputEvent.

common_rubric_option.form: Supported llm-rubric over unchanged final strings or serialized objects; no locally invented normalization or scorer
common_rubric_option.limits: Native matcher defaults missing pass to true. Freeze an explicit required-field schema, threshold and wrong/empty/false-positive controls. Retain grading transport/parse errors and raw missing usage. Grader cost is separate from target cost.

broader_source_pool.name: SWRBench
broader_source_pool.sampling: Six lowest SHA256(seed+newline+stratum+newline+instance_id) in each issue/clean stratum; deterministic proposal before outputs, not a comparative freeze
broader_source_pool.native_scorer: swrbench/evaluation_struct.py; predictions {instance_id,review}; unchanged LLM-judged GT-POINT match and clean-review severity, not executable defect tests
broader_source_pool.native_generation_context: swrbench/generation.py:create_prinfo_prompt uses only pr_title, pr_statement and pr_commits message/diffs; never pass the complete row, oracle changes, repair timeline or all_commits to a worker
broader_source_pool.source_failure: swrbench/utils.py line13 subscripts os.getenv, a function. Native generator and scorer import this helper. Source-level import failure inferred without execution or reading environment values; no local repair adopted.
broader_source_pool.cutoff_rule: Builder keeps date<=created_at commits, sorts by date, and uses the first commit parent and last commit as checkout endpoints. Its older defects/defect_introduced output schema differs from the balanced released changes/change_introduced rows; validate released-row adherence before binding worker heads.
broader_source_pool.limits: Observed dataset has no head_commit field. Establish native reconstruction and exclude later fixes/labels before any tool-based review. MIT repository attribution does not settle every underlying source licence. No reasoning-effort parameter is forwarded by pinned run_chat; Astra/max route remains unqualified.

design.attempt_order: blocked paired tasks; rotate arm order; retain all outcomes

selection_rule.prerequisites: Same hidden oracle and worker-visible context; complete controls, lifecycle, route and useful org-extension activation
selection_rule.quality: Paired no-regression on every task/repeat and more accepted useful issue findings without new false positives; require independent consequential-judgment read
selection_rule.tie: Only complete native counter scopes permit the predeclared five-percent paired-token tie rule; otherwise retain native baseline without claiming a measured win
selection_rule.precision: Declare numeric thresholds against the eventual unchanged oracle before freeze; source features and toy calibration cannot select a default

freeze_gaps: Executable maintained broader oracle or a frozen supported promptfoo rubric
Useful activation of each selected own-org bundle
Native capture contract for final review artifacts and complete counters
Actual Sol/Ultra and Astra/Max route acceptance
Frozen prompts, controls, limits, repeat order and numeric rule
Claude exact-head read and exclusive throwaway allocation
